name: 7-(2-aminopropyl)benzofuran
summary: 7-(2-Aminopropyl)benzofuran (7-APB) is a monoamine releasing agent and designer drug of the benzofuran family, albeit with a potency an order of magnitude less than 6-APB. It acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA). The drug was detected as a novel designer drug, in Europe, by 2013.

pharmacology.text: 7-(2-Aminopropyl)benzofuran (7-APB) is a monoamine releasing agent and designer drug of the benzofuran family, albeit with a potency an order of magnitude less than 6-APB. It acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).

uses.text: 7-(2-Aminopropyl)benzofuran (7-APB) is a monoamine releasing agent and designer drug of the benzofuran family, albeit with a potency an order of magnitude less than 6-APB. The drug was detected as a novel designer drug, in Europe, by 2013.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: Moving the side chain to the 7 position of the benzofuran ring makes it about ten times weaker than 6-APB, a clear example of how much position matters.
fact.zh: 把側鏈移到苯并呋喃環的第7位，使它的效力比6-APB弱約十倍，清楚說明位置有多重要。
fact.zhHans: 把侧链移到苯并呋喃环的第7位，使它的效力比6-APB弱约十倍，清楚说明位置有多重要。
